event.title: October 2nd Friday Artwalk
event.description:
Cheyenne Second Friday Artwalk is the community’s monthly celebration of artists and their work. During Artwalk, Cheyenne galleries, businesses, restaurants, and other places showcase a local or regional visual artist or musician, accompanied by light food and beverages. Artwalk patrons visit the venues on an unstructured schedule, walking, driving or biking.

Cheyenne Second Friday Artwalk takes place on the 2nd Friday of each month from 5:00 – 8:00 pm.
event.excerpt:
This year, join the 11 venues we have open and take a break from the reality of life for your evening…
Support local businesses, artists, and creatives with us EVERY 2nd Friday!

event.title: Intuitive Acrylic Painting with Collage
event.description: Express your creativity in “Intuitive Acrylic Painting with Collage”, a class that moves you beyond the pressure of perfection and into a state of flow. This class blends the versatility of acrylics with the tactile discovery of collage. Explore techniques for layering paint, mark-making, and using paper elements as both a foundation and a finishing touch. This class provides a supportive environment to embrace happy accidents and discover your own unique style. Participants are welcome to bring ephemera from home to add to your piece such as ticket stubs, receipts, book pages, hand-written letters, etc.
event.excerpt: Move beyond perfection and find your flow, blending acrylics and collage through layering, mark-making, and personal keepsakes.

event.title: Interactive Waterfall Journal
event.description:
Learn how to create a beautiful interactive waterfall journal insert. This is a charming layered feature that reveals hidden photos, journaling spots, and surprises with a simple pull. In this hands-on class, you’ll learn the construction technique, explore creative decorating ideas, and make your own vintage-inspired waterfall element to add personality and movement to your journal. This waterfall technique is also great for gluing into a sketchbook or adding on to the front of a greeting card. No prior experience necessary, just bring your creativity!

Materials will be provided, but participants are welcome to bring any paper, photos, or other materials they’d like to add. Feel free to bring a journal, sketchbook, etc. if you’d like to see how the waterfall sits inside.
event.excerpt: Create a mesmerizing waterfall effect in your journal or give as a gift to a friend!
